name: init_called
description: init() method defined but never called in bootstrap code (main.ts / index.ts)
source: Section 3.2 Direction 3 — 集成链路强制检查 #1: init/load 链路
rationale: Tower Stack 3D fatal bug: SoundManager.init() defined but never called from main.ts, causing audio to silently never start. The 'form compliance trap' produces the class with init() but skips wiring it into bootstrap.
